he.title: Historic England · Байесовское хронологическое моделирование
he.passage: The modeling guidance distinguishes the standardized likelihood of a radiocarbon result, Bayesian estimates, and agreement. Example dates can be simulated from a calendar age, calibration curve and measurement error. It also explains model down-weighting for outliers and hypothetical phase boundary estimates.

heRc.title: Historic England · Радиоуглеродное датирование
heRc.passage: The reporting guidance illustrates that a desired probability can be represented by several separate calendar ranges. The calibration curve combines measurements on samples of known age.

oxcal.title: Оксфордский университет · Аналитические операции OxCal
oxcal.passage: Describes representing uncertain dates as likelihood functions and performing calculations on their parameters.

outlier.title: К. Бронк Рэмзи · Работа с выбросами при радиоуглеродном датировании
outlier.passage: Article describes formal outlier models and different ways dates can depart from an inferred event. General time-offset models allow deviations in both directions.

zoo.title: Музей штата Иллинойс · Количество животных и объём мяса
zoo.passage: MNI is calculated per taxon and unit of analysis from the most abundant singly occurring element, considering side, size and age. NISP counts identifiable specimens, with taxonomic resolution and rules documented. Published examples estimate meat mass by applying an average per animal.

tab.title: Oxford Archaeology · Отчёт о раскопках в Уикфорде
tab.passage: Table 10 records NISP and MNI plus each as a percentage by taxon; nearby tables record element and weight in grams.

note: CURRENT removes definition leaks to 025 and between the Bayesian cards, and separates depositional intrusion from old-wood offset. The fauna prompts ask about different counting procedures.
